name: OpenStax
summary: Free textbooks online and as PDFs, with titles for high school and AP courses in math, science and social studies on its K12 pages.
grades: high school (many titles are introductory college texts)

license.note: Since April 2026, new and updated editions are CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (non-commercial). A few current titles (Physics, Statistics) and retired editions remain CC BY 4.0; check each book.

cite: OpenStax, https://openstax.org (cite the book and edition used).

fits.how: Its chapters could be an activity's readings or a Knowledge step's sources; most current editions only for non-commercial use.

connect.note: Books as web pages and PDFs, with a different license by edition, most now non-commercial. Not connected until a book can be fetched as text with its license checked book by book.
